main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight, though nothing is on the schedule yet, and that a Gaethje rematch or a Pimblett fight would both be fine.
note: White's quote 'No lo tenemos en la agenda por ahora, pero... Topuria está listo para pelea' is the promotion stating he is ready with nothing booked and opponents only as options; the June loss and fractures are recap, and Topuria's own statement is only described.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but has had no talks, lists other possible opponents and hopes to return in December.
note: Pimblett's 'I'd love to smash his head in, lad' is a callout in his own news, with only recap about Topuria. Act could be none_of_these since most of it is Pimblett on his own next fight; fact could be next_fight (rumour) for 'growing chatter' of a Gaethje rematch and 'Nothing yet' on talks, but the chatter has no who, date or event.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria but nobody has spoken to him about it, and names other opponents for a hoped-for December return.
note: Pimblett's 'I'd love to smash his head in' is the callout; everything about Topuria (the loss, the fractures, the essay, the stool trolling) is recap, though it is long enough that one_of_several is arguable. 'Rumors swirling' of a Topuria-Pimblett fight has no who, date or event and Pimblett says 'Nothing yet', so I read it as a wish piece rather than next_fight at rumour.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he wants to fight Topuria or Arman Tsarukyan next.
note: Pimblett's 'I think he's a little helmet, I'd love to fight him' is a callout in his own news. The writer adds 'Topuria, however, does not have a fight booked, so that matchup is very much in play', which could be read as weighing his options (one_of_several) or as a nothing-booked status_update, but it is the writer's aside, not a statement from a named source.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at UFC Paris and then called out Daniel Rodriguez.
note: A round-by-round fight report ending in 'Official decision: Daniil Donchenko defeated Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision'; his callout of Rodriguez is described, not quoted, and the embedded posts are not his.

main_claim: Daniil Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision at the UFC event in Paris.
note: A fight report with the scorecards (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) and a round-by-round account; his callout of Rodriguez and his earlier wish to fight in Paris are only described, and the embedded post is the UFC's.

main_claim: In his first statement after losing the lightweight title to Gaethje, Topuria praised him, made no excuses, said he lost vision in both eyes during the fight, and plans to heal and seek a rematch.
note: The article is built on his Instagram statement, where he 'detailed... vision loss in both eyes during the fight', his own statement of his condition, so health; no_fact is arguable since it is mostly reflection and a rematch wish. The loss is restated as the setting for the statement (result no, though the text says 'on Sunday' and gives the stoppage), and his post is paraphrased ('wrote there were no excuses'), never quoted.
